"""TLBFA refill forms and all-way coverage."""
from __future__ import annotations

from mmuverify.common.runtime import execution
from mmuverify.tlbfa.model import ALL_STAGE, NO_S2, ONLY_S1, ONLY_S2

from .common import lookup_vpn, make_refill

KINDS = (NO_S2, ONLY_S1, ONLY_S2, ALL_STAGE)


# TLBFA-COMBO-01, TLBFA-REFILL-03
async def test_all_48_ways_are_independently_addressable(tlbfa_env):
    env = tlbfa_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        tags = [0x1000 + way * 3 for way in range(48)]
        for way in range(48):
            data = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, tags[way], 0x100000000 + way)
            await env.refill(data, way, f"way {way}")
        for way in range(48):
            vpn = lookup_vpn(NO_S2, tags[way])
            snap = await env.lookup(vpn, NO_S2, f"way {way} hit")
            assert snap.hit == 1, way
            assert snap.access_bits == way
        for way in range(48):
            assert env.model.valid[way] == 1
        # Clear all hitVecReg bits after the last hit so every bit is observed
        # in both directions.
        miss = await env.lookup(0x3FFFFFFFF, NO_S2, "clear hit vector")
        assert miss.hit == 0


# TLBFA-REFILL-01, TLBFA-REFILL-04, TLBFA-PAGE-05
async def test_every_stage_and_page_form_can_be_installed(tlbfa_env):
    env = tlbfa_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        env.program_context(satp_asid=4, vsatp_asid=4, hgatp_vmid=5)
        way = 0
        for kind in KINDS:
            for page in range(5):
                level = 0 if page == 4 else page
                n = 1 if page == 4 else 0
                high = 0x2000 + (kind * 5 + page) * 0x2000000
                if kind == ONLY_S2:
                    stored_tag = (high << 3) | 0
                else:
                    stored_tag = high
                data = make_refill(
                    kind,
                    level,
                    stored_tag,
                    0x300000000 + way * 0x101,
                    n=n,
                    asid=4,
                    vmid=5,
                    pteidx=(1, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
                )
                await env.refill(data, way, f"kind {kind} page {page}")
                if kind == ONLY_S2:
                    vpn = stored_tag
                elif n:
                    vpn = (stored_tag << 3) | 5
                else:
                    vpn = lookup_vpn(kind, stored_tag)
                snap = await env.lookup(vpn, kind, f"kind {kind} page {page} hit")
                assert snap.hit == 1, (kind, page, hex(vpn))
                way += 1
        assert way == 20


# TLBFA-SFENCE-09

"""TLBFA sfence/hfence semantics."""
from __future__ import annotations

from mmuverify.common.runtime import execution
from mmuverify.tlbfa.model import ALL_STAGE, NO_S2, ONLY_S1, ONLY_S2

from .common import lookup_vpn, make_refill


def addr_of(tag: int, low: int = 0) -> int:
    return (((tag & ((1 << 35) - 1)) << 3) | (low & 7)) << 12


# TLBFA-SFENCE-01
async def test_sfence_all_address_all_asid_clears_no_s2_only(tlbfa_env):
    env = tlbfa_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        env.program_context(satp_asid=1, vsatp_asid=1, hgatp_vmid=3)
        a = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, 0x20000, 0x100000001, asid=1)
        b = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, 0x20100, 0x200000002, asid=1, perm_g=1)
        c = make_refill(ONLY_S1, 0, 0x20200, 0x300000003, asid=1, vmid=3)
        d = make_refill(ONLY_S2, 0, (0x20300 << 3) | 0, 0x400000004, vmid=3)
        await env.refill(a, 0, "no-s2")
        await env.refill(b, 1, "global no-s2")
        await env.refill(c, 2, "only-s1")
        await env.refill(d, 3, "only-s2")
        await env.fence("all_all", 1, 1, 0, 0, note="all/all")
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, 0x20000), NO_S2, "A cleared")).hit == 0
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, 0x20100), NO_S2, "B cleared")).hit == 0
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(ONLY_S1, 0x20200), ONLY_S1, "C survives")).hit == 1
        assert (await env.lookup((0x20300 << 3), ONLY_S2, "D survives")).hit == 1
        env.sample_fence("all_all", ["stage1_cleared", "stage2_survived"])


# TLBFA-SFENCE-02, TLBFA-SFENCE-04
async def test_sfence_all_address_specific_asid_preserves_global_and_other_asid(tlbfa_env):
    env = tlbfa_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        env.program_context(satp_asid=1, vsatp_asid=1, hgatp_vmid=3)

        b = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, 0x21100, 0x200000012, asid=1, perm_g=1)
        c = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, 0x21200, 0x300000013, asid=2)
        d = make_refill(ONLY_S1, 0, 0x21300, 0x400000014, asid=1, vmid=3)
        await env.refill(a, 0, "A")
        await env.refill(b, 1, "B global")
        await env.refill(c, 2, "C other asid")
        await env.refill(d, 3, "D only-s1")
        await env.fence("all_asid", 1, 0, 0, 1, note="all/asid")
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, 0x21000), NO_S2, "A cleared")).hit == 0
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, 0x21100), NO_S2, "B survives")).hit == 1
        env.program_context(satp_asid=2)

        env.sample_fence(

# TLBFA-SFENCE-03, TLBFA-SFENCE-04
async def test_sfence_exact_address_specific_asid_and_global_survival(tlbfa_env):
    env = tlbfa_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        env.program_context(satp_asid=1, vsatp_asid=1, hgatp_vmid=3)
        x, y, z = 0x22000, 0x22100, 0x22200
        a = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, x, 0x100000021, asid=1)
        d = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, x, 0x400000024, asid=2)
        c = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, z, 0x300000023, asid=1)
        b = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, y, 0x200000022, asid=1, perm_g=1)
        await env.refill(a, 0, "A target")
        await env.refill(d, 1, "D other asid same vpn")
        await env.refill(c, 2, "C other vpn")
        await env.refill(b, 3, "B global other vpn")
        await env.fence("addr_asid", 0, 0, addr_of(x), 1, note="addr/asid")
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, x), NO_S2, "A cleared, D does not match asid 1")).hit == 0
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, z), NO_S2, "C survives")).hit == 1
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, y), NO_S2, "B global survives")).hit == 1
        env.program_context(satp_asid=2)
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, x), NO_S2, "D survives")).hit == 1
        # Install a global translation at the same address, then use the
        # address + all-ASID form. In this design that form clears the global
        # entry; the other-ASID entry remains.
        global_x = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, x, 0x500000025, asid=1, perm_g=1)
        await env.refill(global_x, 4, "global at X")
        env.program_context(satp_asid=1)
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, x), NO_S2, "global at X before fence")).hit == 1
        await env.fence("addr_all_asid", 0, 1, addr_of(x), 1, note="addr/all-asid")
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, x), NO_S2, "global at X cleared")).hit == 0
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, z), NO_S2, "C still survives")).hit == 1
        env.program_context(satp_asid=2)
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, x), NO_S2, "D cleared by address-only all-ASID form")).hit == 0
        env.program_context(satp_asid=1)
        env.sample_fence("addr_asid", ["stage1_cleared", "global_survived", "other_asid_survived"])
        env.sample_fence("addr_all_asid", ["global_cleared", "other_asid_cleared"])

"""Toggle-directed legal stimulus for TLBFA state and public inputs."""
from __future__ import annotations

from mmuverify.common.runtime import execution
from mmuverify.tlbfa.model import ALL_STAGE, NO_S2

from .common import lookup_vpn, make_refill

ALL_ONES = (1 << 50) - 1


# TLBFA-COMBO-01: every storage bit in every way must be exercised in both
# directions. The all-ones payload is intentionally outside the normal PTW
# response distribution; it is a legal interface stimulus for storage testing.
async def test_all_storage_bits_toggle_in_every_way(tlbfa_env):
    env = tlbfa_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        ones = make_refill(
            ALL_STAGE,
            3,
            (1 << 35) - 1,
            (1 << 41) - 1,
            n=1,
            asid=(1 << 16) - 1,
            vmid=(1 << 14) - 1,
            perm_g=1,
            valididx=(1,) * 8,
            pteidx=(1,) * 8,
            ppn_low=(7,) * 8,
            s1_pf=1,
            s1_af=1,
            s2_gpf=1,
            s2_gaf=1,
            pbmt=3,
            g_pbmt=3,
            s2_tag=(1 << 38) - 1,
            s2_ppn=(1 << 38) - 1,
            s1_perm_r=1,
            s1_perm_w=1,
            s1_perm_x=1,
            s2_perm_a=1,
            s2_perm_x=1,
            s1_perm_a=1,
            s1_perm_u=1,
        )
        zeros = make_refill(
            NO_S2,
            0,
            0,
            0,
            valididx=(0,) * 8,
            pteidx=(0,) * 8,
            ppn_low=(0,) * 8,
            s1_perm_r=0,
            s1_perm_w=0,
            s1_perm_x=0,
            s2_perm_a=0,
            s2_perm_x=0,
            s1_perm_a=0,
            s1_perm_u=0,
            s1_v=0,
        )
        for way in range(48):
            await env.refill(ones, way, f"ones way {way}")
        # Reset clears validity but deliberately leaves the payload registers
        # intact; this is the 1->0 edge for the valid bits.
        await env.reset("with_valid_entries")
        for way in range(48):
            await env.refill(zeros, way, f"zeros way {way}")
        await env.settle(2)


# TLBFA-HIT-02: VPN and stage bits in the request path toggle, with a model
# check on every access.
async def test_request_vpn_and_stage_bits_toggle(tlbfa_env):
    env = tlbfa_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        entry = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, 0x31000, 0x111111111, asid=0)
        await env.refill(entry, 0, "toggle anchor")
        for vpn in (0, 0x3FFFFFFFFF, 0x1555555555, 0x2AAAAAAAAAA, 0x1):
            snap = await env.lookup(vpn, NO_S2, f"vpn {vpn:#x}")
            assert snap.hit == (1 if vpn == lookup_vpn(NO_S2, 0x31000) else 0)
        for stage in (NO_S2, 1, 2, ALL_STAGE, ALL_STAGE, NO_S2):
            await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, 0x31000), stage, f"stage {stage}")


# TLBFA-CTX-01: CSR context bits are all exercised.
async def test_context_input_bits_toggle(tlbfa_env):
    env = tlbfa_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()

        env.program_context(satp_asid=0xFFFF, vsatp_asid=0xFFFF, hgatp_vmid=0x3FFF, virt=1, bme=1, cmode=1)
        env.drive_raw_csr(hgatp_vmid=0xFFFF)
        await env.edge()

        assert env.read(env.csr["vsatp_asid"]) == 0xFFFF

        env.program_context(satp_asid=0, vsatp_asid=0, hgatp_vmid=0, virt=0, bme=0, cmode=0)
        await env.edge()


# TLBFA-SFENCE-03: sfence address/id bits are exercised by legal address-only
# fences that must not match the installed translation.
async def test_sfence_address_and_asid_bits_toggle(tlbfa_env):
    env = tlbfa_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        env.program_context(satp_asid=1)
        anchor = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, 0x32000, 0x222222222, asid=1)
        await env.refill(anchor, 0, "anchor")
        hit_vpn = lookup_vpn(NO_S2, 0x32000)
        cases = [
            (0, 0),
            (ALL_ONES, 0xFFFF),
            (0x2AAAAAAAAAAA, 0x5555),
            (0, 0),
        ]
        for addr, sfence_id in cases:
            await env.fence("addr_asid", 0, 0, addr, sfence_id, note="input bits")
            snap = await env.lookup(hit_vpn, NO_S2, "anchor survives non-matching fence")
            assert snap.hit == 1

"""Reference helpers for the TLBNonBlock DTLB tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

from mmuverify.tlbfa.model import (ALL_STAGE, NO_S2, ONLY_S1, ONLY_S2, Refill,
                                   TlbfaModel, bits)
from tests.tlbfa.common import make_refill

READ = 0
WRITE = 1
EXEC = 2
ATOM_WRITE = 5


def dtlb_refill(vaddr: int, ppn: int, kind: int = NO_S2, level: int = 0,
                **overrides) -> Refill:
    """Build a PTW response whose sector lane matches the tested VPN."""
    vpn = (vaddr >> 12) & ((1 << 38) - 1)
    lane = vpn & 7
    defaults = dict(
        kind=kind,
        level=level,
        tag=vpn if kind == ONLY_S2 else (vpn >> 3),
        ppn=ppn >> 3,
        s2_ppn=ppn,
        pteidx=tuple(1 if index == lane else 0 for index in range(8)),
        ppn_low=tuple(ppn & 7 for _ in range(8)),
        s1_perm_r=1,
        s1_perm_w=1,
        s1_perm_x=1,
        s1_perm_u=1,
        s1_perm_a=1,
        s1_perm_d=1,
        s2_perm_a=1,
        s2_perm_d=1,
    )
    defaults.update(overrides)
    return make_refill(**defaults)


def gen_ppn_s1(data: Refill, vpn: int) -> int:
    """Reconstruct the PPN from the sector PPN and the response lane."""
    lane = vpn & 7
    p = (data.s1_ppn & ((1 << 41) - 1)) << 3
    if data.s1_level == 0:
        return (p & ~0x7) | (data.s1_ppn_low[lane] & 7)
    mask = (1 << (9 * data.s1_level)) - 1
    return (p & ~mask) | (vpn & mask)


def gen_ppn_s2(data: Refill, gvpn: int) -> int:
    p = data.s2_ppn
    level = data.s2_level
    if level == 0:
        if data.s2_n:
            return ((p >> 4) << 4) | (gvpn & 0xF)
        return p
    if level == 1:
        return ((p >> 9) << 9) | (gvpn & 0x1FF)
    if level == 2:
        return ((p >> 18) << 18) | (gvpn & 0x3FFFF)
    return ((p >> 27) << 27) | (gvpn & 0x7FFFFFF)


def expected_paddr(data: Refill, vaddr: int) -> int:
    vpn = (vaddr >> 12) & ((1 << 38) - 1)
    off = vaddr & 0xFFF
    s1_ppn = gen_ppn_s1(data, vpn)
    if data.s2xlate in (ONLY_S2, ALL_STAGE):
        gvpn = vpn if data.s2xlate == ONLY_S2 else s1_ppn
        return (gen_ppn_s2(data, gvpn) << 12) | off
    return (s1_ppn << 12) | off


def expected_gpaddr(data: Refill, vaddr: int) -> int:
    """GPA replay address for a leaf response (only stage-2 forms)."""
    vpn = (vaddr >> 12) & ((1 << 38) - 1)
    off = vaddr & 0xFFF
    if data.s2xlate == ONLY_S2:
        return vaddr
    return (gen_ppn_s1(data, vpn) << 12) | off


def expected_pbmt(data: Refill) -> int:
    if data.s2xlate in (NO_S2, ONLY_S1):
        return data.s1_pbmt & 3
    if data.s2xlate == ONLY_S2:
        return data.s2_pbmt & 3
    return (data.s1_pbmt & 3) if (data.s1_pbmt & 3) else (data.s2_pbmt & 3)


def perm_expectations(data: Refill, cmd: int, *, dmode: int = 0, sum_: int = 0,
                      mxr: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Replicate TLB.perm_check for load/store/exec commands."""
    p = data
    stage2 = p.s2xlate in (ONLY_S2, ALL_STAGE)
    s1_valid = p.s2xlate != ONLY_S2
    s2_valid = stage2
    is_ld = cmd == READ
    is_st = cmd in (WRITE, ATOM_WRITE)
    is_inst = cmd == EXEC
    mode_s = dmode == 1
    mode_u = dmode == 0
    mode_ok = not (mode_u and not p.s1_perm_u or
                   mode_s and p.s1_perm_u and not sum_)
    af = bool((p.s2xlate != ONLY_S2 and p.s1_af) or
              (stage2 and p.s2_gaf))
    pf = bool(p.s1_pf)
    ld_update = (not p.s1_perm_a) and is_ld
    st_update = (not p.s1_perm_a or not p.s1_perm_d) and is_st
    ld_fail = not (mode_ok and (p.s1_perm_r or (mxr and p.s1_perm_x)))
    st_fail = not (mode_ok and p.s1_perm_w)
    gpf = bool(p.s2_gpf)
    has_pf = bool((ld_fail or ld_update or st_fail or st_update) and s1_valid
                  and not af)
    g_ld_fail = not (p.s2_perm_r or (mxr and p.s2_perm_x))
    g_st_fail = not p.s2_perm_w
    ld_gpf = bool((g_ld_fail or gpf) and is_ld)
    st_gpf = bool((g_st_fail or gpf) and is_st)
    is_fake = (not p.s1_v) and (not p.s1_pf) and (not p.s1_af) and p.s2xlate != ONLY_S2
    is_nonleaf = (not (p.s1_perm_r or p.s1_perm_w or p.s1_perm_x)) and p.s1_v \
        and (not p.s1_pf) and (not p.s1_af)
    pf_ld = bool((ld_fail or pf or ld_update) and is_ld and s1_valid and not af
                 and not is_fake and not is_nonleaf)
    pf_st = bool((st_fail or pf or st_update) and is_st and s1_valid and not af
                 and not is_fake and not is_nonleaf)
    gpf_ld = bool(ld_gpf and s2_valid and not af and not has_pf)
    gpf_st = bool(st_gpf and s2_valid and not af and not has_pf)
    af_ld = bool(af and is_ld and (s1_valid or s2_valid))
    af_st = bool(af and is_st and (s1_valid or s2_valid))
    return dict(pf_ld=pf_ld, pf_st=pf_st, gpf_ld=gpf_ld, gpf_st=gpf_st,
                af_ld=af_ld, af_st=af_st)

"""TLBNonBlock (MemBlock DTLB) functional tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

from mmuverify.common.runtime import execution
from mmuverify.tlbfa.model import ALL_STAGE, NO_S2, ONLY_S1, ONLY_S2

from tests.tlbn.common import (READ, WRITE, ATOM_WRITE, dtlb_refill, expected_gpaddr,
                     expected_paddr, expected_pbmt, gen_ppn_s1, perm_expectations)


async def _context(env, **values):
    env.set_csr(**values)
    for _ in range(4):
        await env.edge()


def _check_data(snap, data, vaddr, *, cmd=READ, dmode=0, sum_=0, mxr=0,
                note=""):
    if snap.miss:
        return
    assert snap.paddr_0 == expected_paddr(data, vaddr), (
        f"{note}: paddr {snap.paddr_0:#x} != {expected_paddr(data, vaddr):#x}")
    assert snap.pbmt == expected_pbmt(data), f"{note}: pbmt {snap.pbmt}"
    faults = perm_expectations(data, cmd, dmode=dmode, sum_=sum_, mxr=mxr)
    for field, want in faults.items():
        got = getattr(snap, field)
        assert got == want, f"{note}: {field} {got} != {want}"


# DTLB-01: reset leaves every port idle and a bare-mode request passes the
# virtual address through without a PTW request.
async def test_reset_and_bare_mode(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        for port in range(4):
            assert env.read(env.ports[port]["resp"]["valid"]) == 0
            assert env.read(env.ports[port]["ptw"]["valid"]) == 0
        snap = await env.issue(0, 0x12345678, cmd=READ)
        assert snap.valid == 1
        assert snap.miss == 0 and snap.ptw.valid == 0
        assert snap.paddr_0 == 0x12345678
        assert snap.pf_ld == 0 and snap.af_ld == 0 and snap.gpf_ld == 0
        if env.coverage:
            env.coverage.sample("bare", 0, 0, "bare")


# DTLB-02: no_translate returns the supplied PMP address and still raises the
# PMP request with the command.
async def test_no_translate_uses_pmp_addr(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        snap = await env.issue(0, 0x22223333, cmd=WRITE, no_translate=1,
                               pmp_addr=0x00445566)
        assert snap.valid == 1
        assert snap.miss == 0 and snap.ptw.valid == 0
        assert snap.paddr_0 == 0x00445566, hex(snap.paddr_0)
        assert snap.pmp["valid"] == 1 and snap.pmp["addr"] == 0x00445566
        assert snap.pmp["cmd"] == WRITE
        assert snap.pf_ld == 0 and snap.pf_st == 0
        if env.coverage:
            env.coverage.sample("bare", 0, 0, "bare")


# DTLB-03: a no-S2 miss requests the walker with the VPN, and the PTW response
# installs a sector entry that hits with the expected PPN and page offset.
async def test_miss_and_refill_hit(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, satp_mode=8, satp_asid=0, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x12345678
        miss = await env.issue(0, vaddr, cmd=READ)
        assert miss.miss == 1 and miss.ptw.valid == 1
        assert miss.ptw.vpn == (vaddr >> 12) & ((1 << 38) - 1)
        assert miss.ptw.s2xlate == NO_S2 and miss.ptw.get_gpa == 0
        data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, 0x34567)
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7)
        hit = await env.issue(0, vaddr, cmd=READ)
        assert hit.miss == 0 and hit.ptw.valid == 0
        _check_data(hit, data, vaddr, cmd=READ, note="refill hit")
        assert hit.pmp["valid"] == 1 and hit.pmp["addr"] == hit.paddr_0
        assert hit.pmp["cmd"] == READ
        other = (vaddr & ~0xFFF) | 0xABC
        hit2 = await env.issue(0, other, cmd=READ)
        assert hit2.miss == 0 and hit2.paddr_0 == (hit.paddr_0 & ~0xFFF) | 0xABC
        if env.coverage:
            env.coverage.sample("miss", 0, 0, "miss")


# DTLB-04: a 2MB leaf merges the low VPN bits into the PPN; a 1GB leaf merges
# the low 18 bits.
async def test_superpage_ppn_merge(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, satp_mode=9, dmode=0)
        for vaddr, level, ppn in ((0x12340000, 1, 0x40000),
                                  (0x12345000, 1, 0x40000),
                                  (0x40000000, 2, 0x80000)):
            await env.sfence(1, 1, 0, 0)
            miss = await env.issue(0, vaddr, cmd=READ)
            assert miss.miss == 1
            data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, ppn, level=level)
            await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7)
            hit = await env.issue(0, vaddr, cmd=READ)
            assert hit.miss == 0, (vaddr, hit)
            _check_data(hit, data, vaddr, note=f"super {level}")
            assert hit.paddr_0 == expected_paddr(data, vaddr)


# DTLB-05: ASID filtering and full sfence invalidation.
async def test_asid_and_sfence(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, satp_mode=8, satp_asid=3, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x23456000
        assert (await env.issue(0, vaddr)).miss == 1
        data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, 0x22222)
        data.s1_asid = 3
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7)
        assert (await env.issue(0, vaddr)).miss == 0
        await _context(env, satp_asid=4)
        assert (await env.issue(0, vaddr)).miss == 1
        await _context(env, satp_asid=3)
        assert (await env.issue(0, vaddr)).miss == 0
        await env.sfence(1, 1, 0, 0)
        assert (await env.issue(0, vaddr)).miss == 1
        if env.coverage:
            env.coverage.sample("fence", 0, 0, "miss")


# DTLB-06: load permissions: R or MXR+X, and the U/S rule with SUM.
async def test_load_permissions(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, satp_mode=8, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x30000000
        cases = (
            dict(s1_perm_r=0, s1_perm_x=1, mxr=0, pf_ld=1),
            dict(s1_perm_r=0, s1_perm_x=1, mxr=1, pf_ld=0),
            dict(s1_perm_r=1, s1_perm_x=0, mxr=0, pf_ld=0),
        )
        for index, case in enumerate(cases):
            await env.sfence(1, 1, 0, 0)
            v = vaddr + index * 0x1000
            await env.issue(0, v)
            data = dtlb_refill(v, 0x30001 + index,
                               s1_perm_r=case["s1_perm_r"],
                               s1_perm_x=case["s1_perm_x"])
            await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(v >> 12) & 7)
            await _context(env, dmode=0, mxr=case["mxr"])
            hit = await env.issue(0, v, cmd=READ)
            assert hit.miss == 0
            _check_data(hit, data, v, cmd=READ, mxr=case["mxr"],
                        note=f"load perm {index}")
            if case["pf_ld"]:
                if env.coverage:
                    env.coverage.sample("fault", 0, 0, "pf")


# DTLB-07: store requires W and D; AMO write follows the same rule.
async def test_store_permissions(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, satp_mode=8, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x31000000
        cases = (
            dict(perm_w=1, perm_d=1, pf_st=0),
            dict(perm_w=0, perm_d=1, pf_st=1),
            dict(perm_w=1, perm_d=0, pf_st=1),
        )
        for index, case in enumerate(cases):
            await env.sfence(1, 1, 0, 0)
            v = vaddr + index * 0x1000
            await env.issue(0, v)
            data = dtlb_refill(v, 0x31001 + index,
                               s1_perm_w=case["perm_w"],
                               s1_perm_d=case["perm_d"])
            await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(v >> 12) & 7)
            hit = await env.issue(0, v, cmd=WRITE)
            assert hit.miss == 0
            _check_data(hit, data, v, cmd=WRITE, note=f"store perm {index}")
            if case["pf_st"]:
                if env.coverage:
                    env.coverage.sample("fault", 0, 0, "pf")
        # AMO write: cmd 4 is atom_read, 5 is atom_write.  Both are writes for
        # permission purposes; the generated port accepts the full 3-bit cmd.
        await env.sfence(1, 1, 0, 0)
        v = vaddr + 0x3000
        await env.issue(0, v)
        data = dtlb_refill(v, 0x32000, s1_perm_w=0)
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(v >> 12) & 7)
        amo = await env.issue(0, v, cmd=ATOM_WRITE)
        assert amo.miss == 0 and amo.pf_st == 1


# DTLB-08: A/D update faults and access-fault priority.
async def test_ad_and_access_fault_priority(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, satp_mode=8, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x32000000
        for index, (a, d, cmd, want_ld, want_st) in enumerate((
                (0, 1, READ, 1, 0),
                (1, 0, WRITE, 0, 1),
                (1, 1, WRITE, 0, 0))):
            await env.sfence(1, 1, 0, 0)
            v = vaddr + index * 0x1000
            await env.issue(0, v)
            data = dtlb_refill(v, 0x33001 + index, s1_perm_a=a, s1_perm_d=d)
            await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(v >> 12) & 7)
            hit = await env.issue(0, v, cmd=cmd)
            assert hit.pf_ld == want_ld, (index, hit)
            assert hit.pf_st == want_st, (index, hit)
        # Access fault wins over a simultaneous permission/page fault.
        await env.sfence(1, 1, 0, 0)
        v = vaddr + 0x4000
        await env.issue(0, v)
        data = dtlb_refill(v, 0x34000, s1_perm_r=0, s1_af=1)
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(v >> 12) & 7)
        hit = await env.issue(0, v, cmd=READ)
        assert hit.af_ld == 1 and hit.pf_ld == 0, hit
        if env.coverage:
            env.coverage.sample("fault", 0, 0, "af")


# DTLB-09: PBMT composition per translation class.
async def test_pbmt_composition(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, satp_mode=8, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x40000000
        await env.issue(0, vaddr)
        data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, 0x40001, pbmt=2)
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7)
        hit = await env.issue(0, vaddr)
        assert hit.pbmt == 2, hit.pbmt
        # allStage: a non-zero S1 PBMT wins, otherwise the G-stage PBMT is used.
        await _context(env, virt=1, vsatp_mode=8, hgatp_mode=8)
        for index, (s1_pbmt, g_pbmt, want) in enumerate((
                (1, 2, 1), (0, 2, 2))):
            await env.sfence(1, 1, 0, 0)
            v = vaddr + 0x10000 + index * 0x1000
            await env.issue(0, v)
            data = dtlb_refill(v, 0x41001 + index, kind=ALL_STAGE,
                               pbmt=s1_pbmt, g_pbmt=g_pbmt)
            await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(v >> 12) & 7)
            hit = await env.issue(0, v)
            assert hit.miss == 0, hit
            assert hit.pbmt == want, (index, hit.pbmt, want)


# DTLB-10: onlyStage1 uses vsatp and returns the S1 PPN.
async def test_only_stage1(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, virt=1, vsatp_mode=8, vsatp_asid=2,
                       hgatp_mode=0, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x50000000
        miss = await env.issue(0, vaddr)
        assert miss.ptw.s2xlate == ONLY_S1, miss.ptw
        data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, 0x50001, kind=ONLY_S1)
        data.s1_asid = 2
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7)
        hit = await env.issue(0, vaddr)
        assert hit.miss == 0, hit
        _check_data(hit, data, vaddr, note="onlyS1")


# DTLB-11: onlyStage2 uses hgatp, returns the G-stage PPN and reports the VA
# as gpaddr.
async def test_only_stage2(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, virt=1, vsatp_mode=0, hgatp_mode=8,
                       hgatp_vmid=5, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x60000000
        miss = await env.issue(0, vaddr)
        assert miss.ptw.s2xlate == ONLY_S2, miss.ptw
        data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, 0x60001, kind=ONLY_S2)
        data.s2_vmid = 5
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7)
        hit = await env.issue(0, vaddr)
        assert hit.miss == 0, hit
        _check_data(hit, data, vaddr, note="onlyS2")
        assert hit.gpaddr == vaddr


# DTLB-12: allStage clean translation uses the G-stage PPN and checks both
# stages' permissions.
async def test_all_stage_clean(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, virt=1, vsatp_mode=8, hgatp_mode=8, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x61000000
        miss = await env.issue(0, vaddr)
        assert miss.ptw.s2xlate == ALL_STAGE
        data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, 0x61001, kind=ALL_STAGE,
                           s2_perm_r=1, s2_perm_x=1)
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7)
        hit = await env.issue(0, vaddr)
        assert hit.miss == 0, hit
        _check_data(hit, data, vaddr, note="allStage")
        # G-stage load permission failure: the first observation requests the
        # GPA, and the replayed request reports gpf without another walk.
        await env.sfence(1, 1, 0, 0)
        v2 = vaddr + 0x1000
        await env.issue(0, v2)
        bad = dtlb_refill(v2, 0x61002, kind=ALL_STAGE,
                          s2_perm_r=0, s2_perm_x=0, s2_perm_a=0,
                          s2_perm_d=0)
        await env.ptw_respond(bad, addr_low=(v2 >> 12) & 7)
        first = await env.issue(0, v2)
        assert first.miss == 1 and first.gpf_ld == 1, first
        assert first.ptw.valid == 1 and first.ptw.get_gpa == 1, first.ptw
        await env.ptw_respond(bad, addr_low=(v2 >> 12) & 7, get_gpa=1)
        fault = await env.issue(0, v2)
        assert fault.miss == 0 and fault.gpf_ld == 1, fault
        assert fault.gpaddr == expected_gpaddr(bad, v2), (
            hex(fault.gpaddr), hex(expected_gpaddr(bad, v2)))
        if env.coverage:
            env.coverage.sample("fault", 0, 3, "gpf")


# DTLB-13: allStage G-stage page fault triggers a getGpa PTW request; the GPA
# response allows the same page to be reported as gpf with the S1 GPA, without
# another walk request.
async def test_all_stage_gpa_replay(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, virt=1, vsatp_mode=8, hgatp_mode=8, dmode=0)
        vaddr = 0x62000000
        assert (await env.issue(0, vaddr)).miss == 1
        data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, 0x62001, kind=ALL_STAGE,
                          s2_gpf=1, s2_perm_a=0, s2_perm_d=0,
                          s2_perm_x=0)
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7)
        gpf = await env.issue(0, vaddr)
        assert gpf.miss == 1 and gpf.gpf_ld == 1, gpf
        assert gpf.ptw.valid == 1 and gpf.ptw.get_gpa == 1, gpf.ptw
        assert gpf.is_for_vs_nonleaf == 0
        await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7, get_gpa=1)
        replay = await env.issue(0, vaddr)

async def test_four_port_concurrency(tlbn_env):
    env = tlbn_env

        await env.reset()
        await _context(env, satp_mode=8, dmode=0)
        vaddrs = [0x80000000 + index * 0x8000 for index in range(4)]
        for port, vaddr in enumerate(vaddrs):
            entry = env.ports[port]["req"]
            env._set(entry["valid"], 1)
            env._set(entry["vaddr"], vaddr)
            env._set(entry["fullva"], vaddr)
            if "cmd" in entry:
                env._set(entry["cmd"], READ)
        env.dut.RefreshComb()
        await env.edge()
        snaps = []
        for port in range(4):
            resp, ptw, extra = env._request_snap(port)
            snaps.append((resp, ptw, extra))
        for entry in env.ports:
            env._set(entry["req"]["valid"], 0)
        await env.edge()
        for port, (resp, ptw, extra) in enumerate(snaps):
            assert resp["valid"] == 1, port
            assert resp["miss"] == 1, port
            assert ptw.valid == 1 and ptw.vpn == vaddrs[port] >> 12, (port, ptw)
            assert extra["pmp"]["valid"] == 1, port
        # Refill all four translations and check simultaneous hits.
        for port, vaddr in enumerate(vaddrs):
            data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, 0x80001 + port)
            await env.ptw_respond(data, addr_low=(vaddr >> 12) & 7)
        for port, vaddr in enumerate(vaddrs):
            entry = env.ports[port]["req"]
            env._set(entry["valid"], 1)
            env._set(entry["vaddr"], vaddr)
            env._set(entry["fullva"], vaddr)
            if "cmd" in entry:
                env._set(entry["cmd"], READ)
        env.dut.RefreshComb()
        await env.edge()
        hits = [env._request_snap(port)[0] for port in range(4)]
        for entry in env.ports:
            env._set(entry["req"]["valid"], 0)
        await env.edge()
        for port, (vaddr, hit) in enumerate(zip(vaddrs, hits)):
            assert hit["valid"] == 1 and hit["miss"] == 0, (port, hit)
            data = dtlb_refill(vaddr, 0x80001 + port)
            assert hit["paddr_0"] == expected_paddr(data, vaddr), (port, hit)

"""TlbStorageWrapper composition and PLRU replacement tests."""
from __future__ import annotations

from mmuverify.common.runtime import execution
from mmuverify.tlbfa.model import ALL_STAGE, NO_S2, ONLY_S1, ONLY_S2

from ..tlbfa.common import lookup_vpn, make_refill


def pair_for(kind: int, tag: int, low: int = 0) -> tuple[int, int]:
    if kind == ONLY_S2:
        return tag, kind
    return lookup_vpn(kind, tag, low), kind


async def assert_live(env, pairs, note: str):
    live_expected = [
        index for index, (vpn, stage) in enumerate(pairs) if env.model.tlbfa.hit_ways(vpn, stage)
    ]
    probes = await env.probe(pairs)
    live_actual = [index for index, probe in enumerate(probes) if probe.hit]
    assert live_actual == live_expected, f"{note}: live {live_actual} != {live_expected}"


# WRAP-RESET-01, WRAP-REPLACE-01
async def test_reset_and_initial_plru_victim_sequence(wrapper_env):
    env = wrapper_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        pairs = []
        victims = []
        for index in range(60):
            tag = 0x40000 + index * 0x40
            data = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, tag, 0x100000000 + index)
            victim = await env.refill(data, f"refill {index}")
            victims.append(victim)
            pairs.append(pair_for(NO_S2, tag))
        # PLRU starts at zero; these are the first victims of the real wrapper.
        assert victims[0] == 0
        assert victims[1] == 32
        # The pure tree-PLRU fill order leaves ways 15 and 31 untouched during
        # the first 60 refills. Refill once (way 15), then steer with a read
        # hit on way 32 and refill again (way 31); this covers every victim way.
        tag = 0x42000
        victims.append(await env.refill(make_refill(NO_S2, 0, tag, 0x300000000), "victim 15"))
        pairs.append(pair_for(NO_S2, tag))
        tag = 0x42100
        victims.append(await env.refill(make_refill(NO_S2, 0, tag, 0x300000100), "victim 47"))
        pairs.append(pair_for(NO_S2, tag))
        steer = None
        for vpn, stage in pairs:
            if env.model.tlbfa.hit_ways(vpn, stage) == [32]:
                steer = (vpn, stage)
                break
        assert steer is not None, "way 32 must hold a unique translation"
        assert (await env.lookup(steer[0], steer[1], "steer way 32")).hit == 1
        tag = 0x42200
        victims.append(await env.refill(make_refill(NO_S2, 0, tag, 0x300000200), "victim 31"))
        pairs.append(pair_for(NO_S2, tag))
        assert set(victims) == set(range(48)), sorted(set(range(48)) - set(victims))
        assert env.model.tlbfa.valid.count(0) == 0
        await assert_live(env, pairs, "initial PLRU sequence")
        env.coverage.sample_reset("with_valid_entries")


# WRAP-REPLACE-02
async def test_read_hit_changes_next_plru_victim(wrapper_env):
    env = wrapper_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        pairs = []
        for index in range(12):
            tag = 0x50000 + index * 0x40
            data = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, tag, 0x200000000 + index)
            await env.refill(data, f"fill {index}")
            pairs.append(pair_for(NO_S2, tag))
        # Select a currently valid translation and touch it. The next refill
        # must use the PLRU state updated by that read hit.
        live = [index for index, (vpn, stage) in enumerate(pairs) if env.model.tlbfa.hit_ways(vpn, stage)]
        assert live
        chosen = live[len(live) // 2]
        vpn, stage = pairs[chosen]
        snap = await env.lookup(vpn, stage, "touch for replacement")
        assert snap.hit == 1
        tag = 0x51000
        data = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, tag, 0x300000000)
        await env.refill(data, "refill after hit")
        pairs.append(pair_for(NO_S2, tag))
        await assert_live(env, pairs, "after read-hit update")

# WRAP-FENCE-01, WRAP-RESET-01
async def test_sfence_and_hfence_pass_through_without_resetting_plru(wrapper_env):
    env = wrapper_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        env.program_context(satp_asid=1, vsatp_asid=1, hgatp_vmid=3)
        s1 = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, 0x54000, 0x100000021, asid=1)
        s2 = make_refill(ONLY_S2, 0, (0x54100 << 3) | 0, 0x200000022, vmid=3)
        await env.refill(s1, "s1")
        await env.refill(s2, "s2")
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, 0x54000), NO_S2, "s1 before")).hit == 1
        assert (await env.lookup((0x54100 << 3), ONLY_S2, "s2 before")).hit == 1
        await env.fence("all_all", 1, 1, 0, 0, note="sfence")
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, 0x54000), NO_S2, "s1 cleared")).hit == 0
        env.sample_fence("all_all", ["cleared"])
        # The hfence path clears the stage2 entry, not the already-empty s1 way.
        await env.fence("hfencev", 0, 1, 0, 0, hv=1, note="hfencev")
        assert (await env.lookup((0x54100 << 3), ONLY_S2, "s2 cleared")).hit == 0
        env.sample_fence("hfencev", ["cleared"])
        # rs2=0 form exercises the per-way non-global stage2 invalidation
        # expressions even when no entry currently matches.
        await env.fence("hfencev", 0, 0, 0, 1, hv=1, note="hfencev asid")
        env.sample_fence("hfencev", ["cleared"])
        # All-address specific-ASID sfence evaluates the non-virtualized
        # stage1 clear expression for every way.
        await env.fence("all_asid", 1, 0, 0, 1, note="all asid")
        env.sample_fence("all_asid", ["cleared"])
        # Address-specific, all-ASID form executes the address-only clear
        # expression for every way.
        await env.fence("addr_all_asid", 0, 1, 0, 1, note="addr all asid")
        env.sample_fence("addr_all_asid", ["cleared"])
        await env.reset("with_valid_entries")


# WRAP-FENCE-01
async def test_address_sfence_and_hfenceg_pass_through(wrapper_env):
    env = wrapper_env
    async with execution(env.dut):
        await env.reset()
        env.program_context(satp_asid=1, vsatp_asid=1, hgatp_vmid=3)
        x, y = 0x55000, 0x55100
        sx = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, x, 0x100000031, asid=1)
        sy = make_refill(NO_S2, 0, y, 0x200000032, asid=1)
        d3 = make_refill(ONLY_S2, 0, (0x55200 << 3) | 0, 0x300000033, vmid=3)
        d4 = make_refill(ONLY_S2, 0, (0x55300 << 3) | 0, 0x400000034, vmid=4)
        for data in (sx, sy, d3, d4):
            await env.refill(data, "fence entry")
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, x), NO_S2, "X before")).hit == 1
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, y), NO_S2, "Y before")).hit == 1
        await env.fence("addr_asid", 0, 0, x << 15, 1, note="address fence")
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, x), NO_S2, "X cleared")).hit == 0
        assert (await env.lookup(lookup_vpn(NO_S2, y), NO_S2, "Y survived")).hit == 1
        env.sample_fence("addr_asid", ["cleared", "survived"])
        assert (await env.lookup((0x55200 << 3), ONLY_S2, "D3 before")).hit == 1
        env.program_context(hgatp_vmid=4)
        assert (await env.lookup((0x55300 << 3), ONLY_S2, "D4 before")).hit == 1
        await env.fence("hfenceg", 0, 0, 0, 4, hg=1, note="hfenceg vmid")
        assert (await env.lookup((0x55300 << 3), ONLY_S2, "D4 cleared")).hit == 0
        env.program_context(hgatp_vmid=3)
        assert (await env.lookup((0x55200 << 3), ONLY_S2, "D3 survived")).hit == 1
        env.sample_fence("hfenceg", ["cleared", "survived"])
        await env.fence("hfenceg", 0, 1, 0, 0, hg=1, note="hfenceg all")
        env.sample_fence("hfenceg", ["cleared"])

# WRAP-LOOKUP-01: input context and fence address bits are all exercised by
# legal stimuli; the anchor entry must survive non-matching address fences.
async def test_wrapper_context_and_fence_input_bits_toggle(wrapper_env):
    env = wrapper_env

        await env.edge()
        env.program_context(satp_asid=0xFFFF, vsatp_asid=0xFFFF, hgatp_vmid=0x3FFF, virt=1, bme=1, cmode=1)

        env.program_context(satp_asid=1)
